result.instructions: Tools for Service Fusion, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which jobs are scheduled for tomorrow and who is assigned to each?"; "Show the unpaid invoices from the last 30 days."; "When is an HVAC technician free this week for a 2-hour visit?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Service Fusion data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run servicefusion_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run servicefusion_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run servicefusion_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. servicefusion_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: servicefusion_get_me
tools.title: Get current user
tools.description: The Service Fusion user the API credentials belong to: id, name and email. Use it to check the connection. GET /me.

tools.name: servicefusion_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List customers (newest id order unless sorted). Filter by name, contact, address, city, postal code, phone, email, tags or last-serviced date. Add expand=contacts,locations,custom_fields to include them. GET /customers.

last_serviced_from.description: Last serviced on or after this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

last_serviced_to.description: Last serviced on or before this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

expand.description: Extra data to include: contacts, contacts.phones, contacts.emails, locations, custom_fields.

sort.description: Sort fields, comma-separated; a leading - sorts descending (for example -updated_at,customer_name).

fields.description: Only return these fields, comma-separated (for example id,customer_name). Default: all.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

fields.description: Only return these fields, comma-separated (for example id,customer_name). Default: all.

tools.name: servicefusion_list_calendar_tasks
tools.title: List calendar tasks
tools.description: List calendar tasks (appointments and to-dos on the schedule) for one day (start_date or end_date alone), a date range (both) and/or given users. A task is returned when it overlaps the range. GET /calendar-tasks.

start_date.description: Range start, yyyy-mm-dd. Give BOTH start_date and end_date for a range; with only one of them the API returns tasks on that single day.

end_date.description: Range end, yyyy-mm-dd. Give BOTH start_date and end_date for a range; with only one of them the API returns tasks on that single day.

tools.name: servicefusion_get_availability
tools.title: Get technician availability
tools.description: Open time slots for technicians and/or crews over up to 8 days (end_date at most 7 days after start_date). Filter by technician, crew, department, experience level and slot length. GET /availability.

end_date.description: Last day (inclusive), yyyy-mm-dd; at most 7 days after start_date.

scope.description: Individual technician slots, crew slots, or both (the API default is techs; pass all to include crews).

start_time.description: Only slots starting at or after this time of day, HH:MM.

end_time.description: Only slots ending at or before this time of day, HH:MM.

sort.description: Sort by date and/or duration, e.g. date,-duration (API default: date).

ignore_work_schedule.description: Ignore each technician's work schedule; only the time window limits the slots.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: servicefusion_create_customer
tools.title: Create customer
tools.description: WRITE: create a customer in Service Fusion, optionally with contacts (phones, emails) and service locations. It is visible to the whole team and cannot be deleted through this API; creating the same name twice makes two customers, so search with servicefusion_list_customers first. POST /customers.

parent_customer.description: Name of an existing parent customer.

customer_contact.description: Name of the contact for this location.

custom_fields.description: Custom fields: [{name, value}] with names as configured in Service Fusion.

tools.name: servicefusion_create_job
tools.title: Create job
tools.description: WRITE: create a job (work order) for a customer, optionally with address, category, source, assigned technicians, tasks, notes, products, services and other charges. It appears on the team's schedule and cannot be deleted through this API; creating twice makes two jobs. Look up category, source and status names with the list tools first. POST /jobs.

customer_name.description: Customer name exactly as in Service Fusion (see servicefusion_list_customers); an unknown name is created as a new customer.

custom_fields.description: Custom fields: [{name, value}] with names as configured in Service Fusion.

product.description: The product name as in your Service Fusion price list.

service.description: The service name as in your Service Fusion price list.

tools.name: servicefusion_create_estimate
tools.title: Create estimate
tools.description: WRITE: create an estimate (quote) for a customer, optionally with address, category, source, technicians, tasks, notes, products, services, other charges and tags. It cannot be deleted through this API; creating twice makes two estimates. POST /estimates.

customer_name.description: Customer name exactly as in Service Fusion (see servicefusion_list_customers); an unknown name is created as a new customer.

custom_fields.description: Custom fields: [{name, value}] with names as configured in Service Fusion.

product.description: The product name as in your Service Fusion price list.

service.description: The service name as in your Service Fusion price list.
